title: Later-Month Family Relief per Day - TRICARE Reserve Select
content:
**Accounting rule - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

The daily amount the later-month family relief withdraws follows what was paid on the adjustment: where no payment stands against it, it is the amount of the adjustment divided by the days it covers; where a payment covers only part of it, it is the part still unpaid divided by those days; otherwise nothing is withdrawn, the paid adjustment is credited back with the Reserve Select closing reconciliation instead.

The amount of the adjustment is the total of the coverage-type adjustment bills for the latest-billed month, and the days it covers are the total of the days those bills cover; the payment is what is posted against the adjustment bill.

| Payment against the adjustment of 240.65 covering 31 days (hypothetical) | Withdrawn per day |
|---|---|
| none | 240.65 divided by 31, 7.7629 |
| 120.00 | 120.65 divided by 31, 3.8919 |
| 240.65 | nothing |
